history.summary: New-launch 4BR in Hillview (D23) at $2.4M / $2083 PSF, completing 2030, but 1.18km / 14-min walk from Hillview MRT and outside any major growth corridor. Priced near the $2158 district median with no project-specific resale track record and a soft, supply-heavy OCR submarket.
history.rating_rationale: $2083 PSF is below the $2158 D23 median (189 txns) and tenure is fresh 99yr, but Hillview is a mature, car-dependent OCR pocket with no MRT-on-doorstep and no JLD/PDD-style catalyst. New-launch bias flag means the headline price embeds developer pricing; $2.4M for a 4BR is at the upper end of OCR buyer-pool depth. Decent but unexciting hold.
red_flags: 1.18km/14-min walk to MRT — weak transit access for OCR
New-launch pricing bias; no resale track record to verify appreciation
$2.4M 4BR sits at the thinner end of the OCR buyer pool
catalysts: Fresh 99yr lease and new condo facilities
